themes.pain_point: Finance teams spend excessive time manually exporting, importing, and checking transaction data line-by-line against accounting software and bank records to locate discrepancies and handle refunds.
themes.interpretation: The lack of direct integrations with accounting packages and automated transaction-matching tools forces finance staff to perform laborious manual verification. While there is a strong desire to eliminate manual line-by-line checks, some users value control and prefer automated discrepancy-highlighting rather than complete, hands-off automation.
themes.potential_opportunity: Develop a dedicated reconciliation view that highlights only unmatched transactions, supports clearer refund-to-payment mapping, and allows export/integration options that preserve manual approval control for users.

themes.theme: Lack of real-time visibility and proactive alerts for payment issues
themes.pain_point: Administrators and managers do not receive immediate or clear alerts when payments fail or remain pending, leading to delayed discovery of issues and anxious customers contacting support to verify transactions.
themes.interpretation: Without automated notifications or clear real-time status updates on the dashboard, teams are reactive, often only discovering failed or stuck payments when customers call or during end-of-month reconciliation.
themes.potential_opportunity: Implement real-time failure alerts, push notifications for long-pending payments, more descriptive error reasons on failed transactions, and an exception-focused dashboard or report for managers.
